title: Menopause — overview
claims: Menopause usually affects women between the ages of 45 and 55, but it can happen earlier.
Perimenopause is when you have symptoms of menopause but your periods have not stopped; menopause is reached when you have not had a period for 12 months.
Menopause and perimenopause symptoms can start years before periods stop and carry on afterwards.
Menopause affects anyone who has periods and can happen naturally, after surgery to remove the ovaries or uterus, after cancer treatment such as chemotherapy, or for a genetic reason.
